title: Utility Complaint/Information
description: Use this service request for utility complaints or utility information. If request is related to an Out of Order Street Light, please use SR type "Street Lighting - Maintenance." The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 10 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a utility service or equipment in a street or alley.
actions.why: For a utility-service complaint or information request, such as a high bill, service quality, disconnected or unavailable service, or another concern, or for utility equipment in a street or alley such as wires on the ground, damaged poles or boxes, work-crew debris, graffiti, leaning poles, low wires, open trenches, or tree limbs in utility lines. The request form distinguishes utility service from street/alley equipment and asks which utility, provider, equipment problem, and location; these fields collect details rather than establish additional eligibility limits.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Utility Complaint/Information" requests does not apply to an out-of-order street light. If a street light is mounted on a wooden pole, then report it directly to Oncor. If the street light is not mounted on a wooden pole, then submit a "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Utility Complaint/Information"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Utility Complaint/Information"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for an out-of-order street light.
actions.why: For an out-of-order street light. The description for "Utility Complaint/Information" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs this concern to "Street Lighting - Maintenance". The public "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" service has an online request form for street, pedestrian, and highway or freeway lighting.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" requests is not the route for street lights mounted on wooden poles. If the street light is mounted on a wooden pole, then report it directly to Oncor.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Contact Oncor about an out-of-order street light on a wooden pole.
actions.why: For an out-of-order street light mounted on a wooden pole. The description for "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs this pole type to Oncor at 1-888-313-4747 or through its "Click Here" link.
actions.how: Call 1-888-313-4747 or use the "Click Here" link in the "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" description
actions.how_formatted: Call [1-888-313-4747](tel:18883134747) or use the "Click Here" link in the "Street Lamp/Light Maintenance" description
